title: On the Algorithmic Bias of Aligning Large Language Models with RLHF: Preference Collapse and Matching Regularization
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical and statistical aspects of RLHF alignment, specifically addressing 'preference collapse' where minority opinions are ignored.
